name: Bgil Films & Technologies Ltd.
summary: BGIL Films & Technologies Limited operates as an infotainment company in India. The company produces and distributes feature and digital films; produces television serials and programmes; produces multi-media and animation films; and provides post-production services for films. It also operates WayToStardom.com, a web-based portal for Bollywood and entertainment industry; a 4G technology-based mobile entertainment portal; and todaybollywood.com, a news and entertainment portal. In addition, the company provides event, branding, digital signage, and flex fusion services. BGIL Films & Technologies Limited was formerly known as Nam Credit & Investment Consultants Limited and changed its name to BGIL Films & Technologies Limited in June 2007. BGIL Films & Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Noida, India.
